fusions.name: Blighted Fletching
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. Looses 3 spore-tipped arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 piercing damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Full-Draw Harvest
fusions.desc: A full-draw shot that uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 18 piercing damage, 50% more for each one used, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 9 tiles.

fusions.name: Puffball Sentry
fusions.desc: Plants a puffball that fires spores for 12 seconds, striking an enemy within 6 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Ripe
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, spores strike the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
